evidence.notes: AssertException inherits local Exception cause accessors.
AssertException returns the default empty inaccessible-fields map.
Constructed local AssertException reports the default line number.
AssertException constructors and setMessage update message text.
Constructed local AssertException reports the default empty stack trace.
AssertException reports its System-qualified type name.
